types.name: Nuclear plant
types.description: Every nuclear power plant with a reactor in service. Value is the plant's net summer capacity from EIA-860M. Reactors out of service are not counted, so idle or restarting plants (e.g. Palisades, Crane/TMI-1) are not shown until EIA lists them as operating again.

types.name: Hydroelectric dam
types.description: Conventional hydro plants of at least 250 MW net summer capacity (EIA-860M). Value is the whole plant's capacity; a dam EIA files as one plant per state (Hoover Dam) is shown once, summed. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Coal mine
types.description: Coal mines producing at least 2 million short tons in the year (EIA mine-level production, placed with MSHA mine coordinates).

types.name: Gold mine
types.description: Gold-ore mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Copper mine
types.description: Copper-ore mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Iron mine
types.description: Iron-ore (taconite) mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Silver mine
types.description: Silver-ore mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Platinum-group mine
types.description: Platinum and palladium mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Molybdenum mine
types.description: Molybdenum-ore mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Lead-zinc mine
types.description: Lead and zinc mines. Active surface or underground mines with at least 100 employees (MSHA's reported headcount, the only size measure available for every mine). Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Rare-earth mine
types.description: Rare-earth ore mines. Every active MSHA-registered site with at least 10 employees, mills included, as it is a scarce strategic mineral. Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Uranium mine/mill
types.description: Uranium mines and mills (in-situ recovery wellfields are mostly not in MSHA's list). Every active MSHA-registered site with at least 10 employees, mills included, as it is a scarce strategic mineral. Mines of the same commodity in one hex are combined. Coordinates and employees are as reported to MSHA; some complexes report their head-office position.

types.name: Coal power plant
types.description: Plants with at least 1,000 MW of coal capacity (EIA-860M). Value is the whole plant's capacity. A plant that qualifies under several fuels is shown once, as its largest qualifying fuel; the tooltip lists its other fuels. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Gas power plant
types.description: Plants with at least 1,500 MW of natural-gas capacity (EIA-860M). Value is the whole plant's capacity. A plant that qualifies under several fuels is shown once, as its largest qualifying fuel; the tooltip lists its other fuels. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Geothermal field
types.description: Geothermal capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 100 MW (EIA-860M). Plants are summed per hex (large projects are filed as many EIA plants), counting this technology's capacity in every plant, including hybrids where it is not the main fuel. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Pumped-storage hydro
types.description: Pumped-storage plants of at least 1,000 MW (EIA-860M): grid batteries made of two reservoirs. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Wind farms
types.description: Wind capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 500 MW net summer capacity (EIA-860M). Plants are summed per hex (large projects are filed as many EIA plants), counting this technology's capacity in every plant, including hybrids where it is not the main fuel. Offshore wind farms are placed on the nearest US coastal hex (up to 3 hexes away). Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Solar farms
types.description: Utility-scale solar capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 500 MW net summer capacity (EIA-860M; rooftop solar is not included). Plants are summed per hex (large projects are filed as many EIA plants), counting this technology's capacity in every plant, including hybrids where it is not the main fuel. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Battery storage
types.description: Battery-storage capacity, shown where a hex totals at least 400 MW (EIA-860M). Plants are summed per hex (large projects are filed as many EIA plants), counting this technology's capacity in every plant, including hybrids where it is not the main fuel. Only generators in service (EIA status operating or standby) count; units out of service are left out.

types.name: Oil (shale play)
types.description: Hexes inside a major tight-oil play (Permian, Bakken/Three Forks, Eagle Ford, Niobrara), thinned to about one hex in four on a regular lattice where no two icons touch; a play too small to hold a lattice hex gets one icon near its centre, or is named in its neighbours' tooltips. Oil vs gas follows EIA's tight-oil and shale-gas production charts. Outlines are geological plays, not production; value is the play's area.

types.name: Natural gas (shale play)
types.description: Hexes inside a major shale-gas play (Marcellus, Utica, Haynesville, Barnett, Fayetteville, Woodford, Mancos), thinned to about one hex in four on a regular lattice where no two icons touch; a play too small to hold a lattice hex gets one icon near its centre, or is named in its neighbours' tooltips. Outlines are geological plays, not production; value is the play's area.
